<!-- Main homepage scroll loader -->
<script>
    var homelist = [{"label":"\u6e2f\u805e","slug":"news","url":"\/news\/\u6e2f\u805e","style":"A","type":"article"},{"label":"\u5a1b\u6a02","slug":"entertainment","url":"\/entertainment\/\u5a1b\u6a02","style":"B","type":"article"},{"label":"\u4e2d\u570b","slug":"china","url":"\/china\/\u4e2d\u570b","style":"A","type":"article"},{"label":"\u570b\u969b","slug":"world","url":"\/world\/\u570b\u969b","style":"A","type":"article"},{"label":"\u661f\u5cf6\u7533\u8a34\u738b","slug":"voice","url":"\/voice\/\u661f\u5cf6\u7533\u8a34\u738b","style":"C","type":"article"},{"label":"\u8ca1\u7d93","slug":"finance","url":"\/finance\/\u8ca1\u7d93","style":"A","type":"article"},{"label":"\u5730\u7522","slug":"property","url":"\/property\/\u5730\u7522","style":"C","type":"article"},{"label":"\u751f\u6d3b","slug":"life","url":"\/life\/\u751f\u6d3b","style":"B","type":"article"},{"label":"\u5065\u5eb7","slug":"health","url":"\/health\/\u5065\u5eb7","style":"B","type":"article"},{"label":"\u6559\u80b2","slug":"education","url":"\/education\/\u6559\u80b2","style":"C","type":"article"},{"label":"\u9ad4\u80b2","slug":"sports","url":"\/sports\/\u9ad4\u80b2","style":"C","type":"article"},{"label":"\u5927\u7063\u5340","slug":"gba","url":"\/gba\/\u5927\u7063\u5340","style":"A","type":"article"},{"label":"\u99ac\u7d93","slug":"racing","url":"\/racing\/\u99ac\u7d93","style":"A","type":"article"},{"label":"TV","slug":null,"url":"\/tv","style":"D","type":"tv"}];
    var allclass = 'cat-layout-1 cat-layout-2 home-section-1';

    // Cache compiled Handlebars templates
    var _compiledTemplates = {};
    function getCompiledTemplate(templateId) {
        if (!_compiledTemplates[templateId]) {
            var source = document.getElementById(templateId);
            if (!source) return null;
            _compiledTemplates[templateId] = Handlebars.compile(source.innerHTML);
        }
        return _compiledTemplates[templateId];
    }

    $(document).ready(function() {
        var listcount = 14;
        var pageindex = 0;
        var lrec_index = 4;
        var leaderboard_index = 1;
        var lazyflag = 0;
        var sticky_billboard = true;
        var is_lastsection = false;
        var $adBillboard = $('div#ad-billborad.home-page');

        page = homelist[pageindex];

        var CUS_CONTROL = {
            is_loading: false,
            fetched_sections: [],
        };

        // Throttled scroll handler via requestAnimationFrame
        var scrollTicking = false;
        $(window).scroll(function() {
            if (!scrollTicking) {
                requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                    handleScroll();
                    scrollTicking = false;
                });
                scrollTicking = true;
            }
        });

        function handleScroll() {
            var page_maker = $('Homeflag[id^=load_next][data-page=' + pageindex + ']');

            if (!CUS_CONTROL.is_loading
                && page_maker.length
                && ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height()) >= page_maker.offset().top
            ) {
                CUS_CONTROL.is_loading = true;
                page = homelist[pageindex];

                if (page === undefined) {
                    is_lastsection = true;
                } else {
                    page_maker.remove();
                    loadnextblock(page, lrec_index, pageindex + 1);
                    pageindex++;
                    if (page.type !== 'tv' || page.type !== 'plus') { lrec_index++; }
                    CUS_CONTROL.fetched_sections.push(page.slug);
                    CUS_CONTROL.is_loading = false;
                }
            }

            if (pageindex === 0 && page_maker.length === 0 && !CUS_CONTROL.fetched_sections.includes(page.slug)) {
                loadnextblock(page, lrec_index, pageindex + 1);
                pageindex++;
                page_maker.remove();
                if (page.type !== 'tv' || page.type !== 'plus') { lrec_index++; }
                CUS_CONTROL.fetched_sections.push(page.slug);
                CUS_CONTROL.is_loading = false;
            }

            if (sticky_billboard && $adBillboard.position().top > 100) {
                sticky_billboard = false;
                setTimeout(function() {
                    $adBillboard.fadeTo('slow', 0.5, function() {
                        $adBillboard.css({ 'position': 'inherit', 'opacity': 1 });
                    });
                }, 3000);
            }
        }
    });

    /**
     * Load a content block and append to #section-news.
     */
    function loadnextblock(page, adindex, blockindex) {
        if (debug_mode) console.log('loadnextblock', { page: page, adindex: adindex, blockindex: blockindex });

        if (page.type === 'tv') page.slug = 'tv';

        if (!page || !page.type || !page.slug || !page.style) {
            if (debug_mode) console.warn('loadnextblock: invalid page object', page);
            return;
        }

        var isSC = String(lang).toLowerCase().startsWith('sc') || String(lang).toLowerCase() === 'zh-cn';
        var langPrefix = isSC ? '/zh-hans' : '';
        var trimmedBase = String(baseUrl || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');

        var url = trimmedBase + langPrefix + '/homeblock/'
            + encodeURIComponent(page.type) + '/'
            + encodeURIComponent(page.slug) + '/'
            + encodeURIComponent(page.style) + '/'
            + encodeURIComponent(adindex) + '/'
            + encodeURIComponent(blockindex);

        if (debug_mode) console.log('loadnextblock URL:', url);

        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
            timeout: 10000,
        })
        .done(function(data) {
            if (!data || (typeof data === 'string' && data.trim() === '')) {
                if (debug_mode) console.log('loadnextblock: empty response');
                return;
            }

            var withoutSectionData = isOnlyHomeflag(data);

            if (page.slug === 'stplus-hit') page.url = '/singtaoplus';

            var header = createSectionHeader(page, blockindex, withoutSectionData);
            var content = createContentContainer(page.type, header, data);

            var $host = $('#section-news');
            if (!$host.length) {
                if (debug_mode) console.warn('#section-news not found');
                return;
            }

            var $content = $(content).hide();
            var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            frag.appendChild($content.get(0));
            $host.append(frag);
            $host.show();
            $content.fadeIn('slow');

            if (page.type !== 'tv' && page.type !== 'plus') {
                try { handleAdObserver(adindex, blockindex); }
                catch (e) { if (debug_mode) console.warn('handleAdObserver failed:', e); }
            }

            try { checkislive(); }
            catch (e) { if (debug_mode) console.warn('checkislive failed:', e); }

            try {
                if (blockindex % 3 === 0) {
                    if (typeof window.l_index !== 'number') window.l_index = 0;
                    initadbanner(window.l_index);
                    window.l_index++;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                if (debug_mode) console.warn('initadbanner failed:', e);
            }
        })
        .fail(function(xhr, status, error) {
            if (debug_mode) {
                console.error('loadnextblock error:', {
                    status: status,
                    error: error,
                    response: xhr && xhr.responseText
                });
            }
        });
    }

    function isOnlyHomeflag(data) {
        if (typeof data !== 'string') {
            console.error('isOnlyHomeflag: Expected string, received:', typeof data);
            return false;
        }

        var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
        tempDiv.innerHTML = data.trim();
        var children = tempDiv.children;
        var result = false;

        if (children.length === 1 && children[0].tagName.toLowerCase() === 'homeflag') {
            result = true;
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
            if (children[i].className && children[i].className.indexOf('cat-layout-') !== -1) {
                result = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (debug_mode) console.log('isOnlyHomeflag:', result);
        return result;
    }

    function createSectionHeader(page, blockindex, with_section_data) {
        if (!with_section_data) {
            return '<div class="home-sec-title content-right content-left" id="sectitle_' + blockindex + '">'
                + page.label
                + '<a class="link-more" href="' + page.url + '">更多</a>'
                + '</div>';
        }
        return '<div class="home-sec-title content-right content-left" id="sectitle_' + blockindex + '"></div>';
    }

    function createContentContainer(pageType, header, data) {
        var containerMap = {
            'tv': '<div class="hometvbg"><div class="container-fluid-1">' + header + data + '</div></div>',
            'plus': '<div class="homeplusbg"><div class="container-fluid-2">' + header + data + '</div></div>',
        };
        return containerMap[pageType] || '<div class="container-fluid-3 homeblockstyle">' + header + data + '</div>';
    }

    function handleAdObserver(adindex, blockindex) {
        arrlrecblock['lrec' + adindex] = false;
        arrlrecblock_m['lrec' + adindex + '_m'] = false;

        var adslotlb = isMobile()
            ? adUnits_m['LREC'][adindex - 1]
            : adUnits['LREC'][adindex - 1];

        if (debug_mode) {
            console.log('blockindex:', blockindex, 'LREC Ad Index:', adindex, 'divid:', adslotlb.divid);
        }

        var targetElement = document.getElementById(adslotlb.divid);
        if (targetElement) {
            lrecObserver.observe(targetElement);
        }
    }

    function initadbanner(adindex) {
        var template = getCompiledTemplate('homelist-template-ad');
        if (!template) return;

        var pagedata = {
            index: adindex,
            indexm: adindex,
            indexd: adindex - 1,
            indexdm: adindex - 1
        };
        var html = template(pagedata);
        $('#section-news').append('<div class="container-fluid-4 homeblockstyle">' + html + '</div>');

        var adslotlb = isMobile() ? adUnits_m['leaderboard'][adindex - 1] : adUnits['leaderboard'][adindex - 1];
        googletag.cmd.push(function() {
            googletag.defineSlot(adslotlb.code, JSON.parse(adslotlb.sizes), adslotlb.divid)
                .addService(googletag.pubads());
            googletag.display(adslotlb.divid);
        });
    }

    function getclassname(style) {
        switch (style) {
            case 'A': return 'cat-layout-1';
            case 'B': return 'cat-layout-2';
            case 'C': return 'home-section-1';
            default:  return '';
        }
    }

    function newscard(arr, index, type) {
        var template = getCompiledTemplate('homelist-template');
        if (!template) return;

        var datacount = (arr.length > 6) ? 6 : arr.length;

        // Shared context — helpers registered once, read from ctx each render
        var ctx = { liveid: '', video: '', sponsor: '', tag: '' };
        Handlebars.registerHelper('liveid', function() { return new Handlebars.SafeString(ctx.liveid); });
        Handlebars.registerHelper('video', function() { return new Handlebars.SafeString(ctx.video); });
        Handlebars.registerHelper('sponsor', function() { return new Handlebars.SafeString(ctx.sponsor); });
        Handlebars.registerHelper('tag', function() { return new Handlebars.SafeString(ctx.tag); });

        arr.slice(0, datacount).forEach(function(item, d) {
            var channelRect = item.channel_rect || {};
            var keyImage = item.key_image || {};
            var fontColor = (channelRect.font_color && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(channelRect.font_color))
                ? 'color:#' + channelRect.font_color
                : '';

            // Update shared context per item (helpers read from ctx)
            ctx.liveid = (item.live_id != null && item.live_id !== '')
                ? "<div id='hit_" + item.live_id + "'></div>" : '';
            ctx.video = (item.video_path === '')
                ? '' : "<div class='video-play'></div><div class='video-time'>" + formatMinsSeconds(item.video_duration) + '</div>';
            ctx.sponsor = (['sponsor', 'sponsor_v2'].includes(item.article_type))
                ? "target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'" : '';
            ctx.tag = (channelRect['url'] == null || channelRect['url'] === '')
                ? "<span class='tag-icon-a'>" + channelRect['name'] + '</span>'
                : "<a onclick=\"Ham5Ham('Mini-Channels');\" class='tag-icon-a' style='" + fontColor + "' href='" + channelRect['url'] + "'>" + channelRect['name'] + '</a>';

            var pagedata = {
                primary: (type === 'lazy' && d === 0) ? 'primary-column ' : '',
                url: (item.redirect_url !== null && item.redirect_url !== '') ? item.redirect_url : item.url,
                cck: (type === 'hit')
                    ? "track_pos('最Hit', '" + (d + 1) + "');"
                    : "track_pos('即時', '" + (d + 1) + "');",
                src: (item.video_path === '') ? keyImage['src'] : item.video_cover_img,
                srcset: keyImage['srcset'],
                alt: keyImage['alt_text'],
                title: item.title,
                background_color: channelRect.background_color,
                font_color: channelRect.font_color,
                time: getSTDateFormat(item.updated_at, lang)
            };
            var html = template(pagedata);

            if (type === 'lazy') {
                $('#classname_' + index).append(html).show().fadeIn('slow');
            } else {
                $('#hitrealdetail' + d).append(html).show().fadeIn('slow');
                $('#hitrealdetail' + d + ' > div.news-block > div').unwrap();
                if ($('#hit_' + item.live_id).length > 0) {
                    checkislivelazy(item.live_id, function(output) {
                        if (output['is_live']) {
                            $('#hit_' + output['live_id']).append(
                                "<div class='live-ing'></div><div class='video-play'></div>"
                            );
                        } else if (output['not_yet_live']) {
                            $('#live_' + item.live_id).append(
                                "<div class='live-notice'><div class='live-notice-title'>預告</div><div class='live-notice-time'>" + output['scheduled_at'] + '</div></div>'
                            );
                        } else if (output['has_playback']) {
                            $('#live_' + item.live_id).append(
                                "<div class='video-play'></div>"
                            );
                        }
                    });
                }
            }

            if (type === 'lazy' && d === 1 && index <= 15) {
                initadblock(index + 3, '#classname_' + index);
            }
            if ($('#lrec3').closest('.news-ad').is(':visible')) {
                $('#hitrealdetail5').hide();
            }
        });
    }

    function newscardB(arr, index, type) {
        if (!Array.isArray(arr) || !arr.length) {
            console.warn('newscardB: Invalid or empty array');
            return;
        }

        var templateId = (type === 'lazy') ? 'homelist-template-B' : 'hit-template';
        var template = getCompiledTemplate(templateId);
        if (!template) {
            console.error('newscardB: Template #' + templateId + ' not found');
            return;
        }

        var pagedata = {
            index: (type === 'lazy') ? index + 4 : 3,
            adindex: (type === 'lazy') ? index + 3 : 2,
        };

        arr.forEach(function(item, i) {
            var channelRect = item.channel_rect || {};
            var keyImage = item.key_image || {};
            var liveId = item.live_id || '';
            var fontColor = (channelRect.font_color && /^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(channelRect.font_color))
                ? 'color:#' + channelRect.font_color
                : '';

            Handlebars.registerHelper('hit_' + i, function() {
                return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                    liveId ? "<div id='hit_" + liveId + "'></div>" : ''
                );
            });

            Handlebars.registerHelper('tag_' + i, function() {
                return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                    (!channelRect.url || channelRect.url === '')
                        ? "<span class='tag-icon-a'" + (fontColor ? " style='" + fontColor + "'" : '') + '>' + Handlebars.escapeExpression(channelRect.name || '') + '</span>'
                        : "<a data-test='w' onclick=\"Ham5Ham('Mini-Channels');cckevent('Mini-Channels','" + Handlebars.escapeExpression(channelRect.name || '') + "','" + Handlebars.escapeExpression(channelRect.url || '') + "');\" class='tag-icon-a' href='" + Handlebars.escapeExpression(channelRect.url || '') + "'" + (fontColor ? " style='" + fontColor + "'" : '') + '>' + Handlebars.escapeExpression(channelRect.name || '') + '</a>'
                );
            });

            Handlebars.registerHelper('video_' + i, function() {
                return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                    (item.video_path && typeof item.video_path === 'string')
                        ? "<div class='video-play'></div><div class='video-time'>" + formatMinsSeconds(item.video_duration || 0) + '</div>'
                        : ''
                );
            });

            Handlebars.registerHelper('des_' + i, function() {
                return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                    (type === 'lazy' && i === 0)
                        ? "</div><div class='des'>" + Handlebars.escapeExpression(item.digest || '')
                        : ''
                );
            });

            Handlebars.registerHelper('sponsor_' + i, function() {
                return new Handlebars.SafeString(
                    ['sponsor', 'sponsor_v2'].includes(item.article_type) ? "target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'" : ''
                );
            });

            pagedata['url_' + i] = (item.redirect_url || item.url) || '#';
            pagedata['cck_' + i] = (type === 'lazy')
                ? "track_pos('" + Handlebars.escapeExpression(page && page.label ? page.label : '') + "'," + i + ");"
                : "track_pos('" + Handlebars.escapeExpression(hitreallabel && hitreallabel[0] ? hitreallabel[0].label : '') + "', " + i + ");";
            pagedata['src_' + i] = item.video_path ? (item.video_cover_img || '') : (keyImage.src || '');
            pagedata['srcset_' + i] = Handlebars.escapeExpression(keyImage.srcset || '');
            pagedata['alt_' + i] = Handlebars.escapeExpression(keyImage.alt_text || '');
            pagedata['title_' + i] = Handlebars.escapeExpression(item.title || '');
            pagedata['background_color_' + i] = Handlebars.escapeExpression(channelRect.background_color || 'FFFFFF');
            pagedata['font_color_' + i] = Handlebars.escapeExpression(channelRect.font_color || '');
            pagedata['time_' + i] = getSTDateFormat(item.updated_at || '', lang);
        });

        var html = template(pagedata);
        var targetDiv = (type === 'lazy') ? '#classname_' + index : '#hitrealnews-list';
        var targetElement = document.querySelector(targetDiv);

        if (targetElement) {
            targetElement.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
            targetElement.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 500 });
        } else {
            console.warn('newscardB: Target div ' + targetDiv + ' not found');
        }

        if (type !== 'lazy') {
            arr.forEach(function(item) {
                if (item.live_id && document.querySelector('#hit_' + item.live_id)) {
                    checkislivelazy(item.live_id, function(output) {
                        var liveElement = document.querySelector('#hit_' + item.live_id);
                        if (!liveElement) return;

                        if (output && output.is_live) {
                            liveElement.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', "<div class='live-ing'></div><div class='video-play'></div>");
                        } else if (output && output.not_yet_live) {
                            var el = document.querySelector('#live_' + item.live_id);
                            if (el) el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
                                "<div class='live-notice'><div class='live-notice-title'>預告</div><div class='live-notice-time'>" + Handlebars.escapeExpression(output.scheduled_at || '') + '</div></div>'
                            );
                        } else if (output && output.has_playback) {
                            var el = document.querySelector('#live_' + item.live_id);
                            if (el) el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', "<div class='video-play'></div>");
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        if (type === 'lazy' && index <= 15) {
            var adslotlb = isMobile()
                ? (adUnits_m && adUnits_m.LREC ? adUnits_m.LREC[index + 3] : null)
                : (adUnits && adUnits.LREC ? adUnits.LREC[index + 3] : null);

            if (adslotlb && adslotlb.divid) {
                var adElement = document.getElementById(adslotlb.divid);
                if (adElement) {
                    lrecObserver.observe(adElement);
                } else {
                    console.warn('newscardB: Ad element #' + adslotlb.divid + ' not found');
                }
            }
        }
    }
</script>
